instruction: Use the Sharpen filter with a 2.0 radius on every desktop image simultaneously, making sure all images have identical settings.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP does not provide batch filter application functionality through its standard GUI. Applying a sharpen filter to multiple images simultaneously requires scripting capabilities (such as Python-Fu or Script-Fu batch processing) that are not accessible in the OSWorld environment.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible with appropriate evaluator function
